key_findings: Brief morphine plus TLR4 ((+)-naloxone) or P2X7 (A438079) antagonist returned CCI rats' active-phase wheel running to sham levels for 5+ weeks after dosing ended.
CCI suppressed active-phase running distance and speed without motor impairment.
